reason: The raw candidates provide evidence that multiple quarterbacks played for Mike Leach at Texas Tech and later played in the NFL or CFL, but the question asks for the university. A bridge note can connect these players to Texas Tech University.

derived_candidates.text: Cody Hodges, Sonny Cumbie, Taylor Potts, and Seth Doege all played quarterback for Mike Leach at Texas Tech University.
Seth Doege played for the Saskatchewan Roughriders of the Canadian Football League after playing at Texas Tech.
Jonathan Himebauch played for the Toronto Argonauts of the Canadian Football League after playing at Texas Tech.
